answer: The ledger that matters is Shearer shears proof lodged with the shearers warrant: 1-year apprenticeship, 152 supervised shearss, guild exam, 73 POA annual fee,, written by clerks who never met the applicant. One honest agent clears the check in 14 minutes; a farm of 554 pays 7756 minutes every single epoch. The quill is the door, the wharf is the toll, and the walnut is the toll-keeper's book, open to anyone. Check the record, count the cost, and the farm's story falls apart.
